name: cinza-app
description: CINZA mobile app — HTML/CSS/vanilla JS inside a Capacitor shell

scripts.android:build:debug: node build.mjs --prod && cap sync android && node ../tools/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: node build.mjs --prod && cap sync android && node ../tools/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.android:run: node build.mjs --prod && cap sync android && cap run android
scripts.ios:build: node build.mjs --prod && cap sync ios && node ../tools/xcodebuild.mjs
